summary: Design lakehouse, ETL/ELT, data contract, and governance blueprints for analytics and AI. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: AI-ready data platform training helps data architects, engineers, and analytics leads plan a move from warehouses to lakehouses. Participants assess data estates, compare lakehouse formats, and map pipelines, data contracts, governance, and lineage to shape phased modernization plans for analytics and AI. Exercises produce an estate assessment, target architecture, governance map, and migration roadmap without requiring production deployment or coding.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals shaping data platform architecture, engineering, governance, and modernization decisions. It suits people who need to translate analytics and AI demand into an actionable platform blueprint.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with data warehouses, data engineering workflows, or analytics platforms is recommended. The course focuses on architecture and planning; coding is not required. Bring a laptop for document and spreadsheet-based exercises. No cloud account or platform installation is required.
